descriptor: Leeds board-game cafe with 400 games and cake

voice.summary: Talks like the loudest, friendliest host at the game table: jokey, welcoming and happy to explain the rules twice. Exclamation is allowed, shouting is not.
dos: Use game verbs like roll, play and teach
Mention cake and tea as freely as games
Give players, time and vibe in plain numbers

taglines: Roll in. Play more. Stay for cake
Learn it, play it, win it
boilerplate: Meeple & Mug is a board-game cafe in Leeds with 400 games, expert hosts who teach the rules, and a proper cake menu.
